title: Text constants shipped as base64, hex, percent and char-code literals decode to data, not code
intent: Synthetic regression for the literal decode folds. A UI string table that ships its constants encoded (base64 greeting and JSON defaults, a hex label, a percent-encoded separator, char codes, a base64 PNG header) beside the bundler global shim decodes to plain text or bytes: no capability may appear and nothing may be marked obfuscated. All samples are inert FileRecord strings.
